name: Account created
subject: Your Alamtri Geo account is ready
body:
Hello {name},

Your Alamtri Geo workspace account has been created and is ready to use. You can now sign in with the username below.

Username: {username}

For your security, you'll be asked to verify a one-time code the first time you sign in. If you did not expect this email, please contact your administrator.

name: Vendor login OTP code
subject: Your Alamtri Geo Vendor Workspace OTP code
body:
Dear {name},

Your One-Time Password (OTP) for signing in to the Alamtri Geo Vendor Workspace is below. It expires in {expiryMinutes} minutes.

OTP code: {code}

Please do not share this code with anyone for security reasons. If you did not request this OTP, please ignore this email or contact our Administrator immediately.

Thank you,
Alamtri Geo Vendor Workspace — Notification System

—

Yth. {name},

Berikut adalah One-Time Password (OTP) untuk masuk ke Alamtri Geo Vendor Workspace. Kode ini berlaku selama {expiryMinutes} menit.

Kode OTP: {code}

Mohon tidak membagikan kode ini kepada siapa pun demi keamanan akun Anda. Apabila Anda tidak meminta OTP ini, mohon abaikan email ini atau hubungi Admin kami segera.

Terima kasih,
Alamtri Geo Vendor Workspace — Sistem Notifikasi

name: Password reset
subject: Reset your Alamtri Geo password
body:
Hello {name},

We received a request to reset the password for your account. Use the button below to choose a new password. This link expires in {expiryHours} hours.

If you didn't request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email — your password will remain unchanged.

name: Password expiring soon
subject: Your password expires in {days} days
body:
Hello {name},

As part of our security policy, your password will expire in {days} days. Please update it before then to avoid losing access to your workspace.

Choose a strong password you haven't used before. Contact your administrator if you need help.

name: Invoice reminder
subject: Reminder: invoice {invoiceId} is due {dueDate}
body:
Hello {name},

This is a friendly reminder that invoice {invoiceId} for {amount} is due on {dueDate}. Please review the details and arrange payment before the due date to avoid late penalties.

If you have already processed this payment, please disregard this reminder.

name: Purchase request approved
subject: Purchase request {prId} has been approved
body:
Hello {name},

Good news — purchase request {prId} ({amount}) has been approved by {approver}. The procurement team will proceed with the next steps and notify the assigned vendor.

You can track the status of this request in your workspace at any time.

name: Purchase request rejected
subject: Purchase request {prId} was not approved
body:
Hello {name},

Purchase request {prId} was reviewed by {approver} and has not been approved at this time.

Reason: {reason}

You may revise and resubmit the request with the required changes. Reach out to your operations manager if you have any questions.

name: Vendor onboarding
subject: Welcome to the Alamtri Geo Vendor Workspace
body:
Hello {vendorName},

You have been onboarded as an approved vendor for Alamtri Geo. Activate your Vendor Workspace account to submit quotes, track purchase orders, and manage invoices.

Your primary contact is {contact}. Please complete your company profile within 14 days of activation.

name: Account suspended
subject: Your account access has been suspended
body:
Hello {name},

Your Alamtri Geo account has been temporarily suspended.

Reason: {reason}

If you believe this is a mistake, please contact {contact} to resolve the issue. Access will be restored once the matter is reviewed.

name: Monthly report ready
subject: Your {month} operations report is ready
body:
Hello {name},

Your operations report for {month} has been generated and is ready to download. It includes activity summaries, approval metrics, and audit highlights for your modules.

Reports are retained for 12 months. Download or archive them as needed.

name: Contract Expiry Reminder — 6 Bulan
subject: Pengingat Kontrak: {contractNo} berakhir dalam ≤ 6 bulan ({daysToExpiry} hari)
intro:
Dear Tim User,

Bersamaan dengan ini kami sampaikan bahwa Perjanjian/Amendment berikut akan berakhir dalam kurun waktu ≤ 6 bulan.
note:
Apabila masih terdapat kebutuhan atas pengadaan Barang dan/atau Jasa sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Perjanjian tersebut, Pihak User diwajibkan untuk menyampaikan proposal kepada Tim Vendor Onboarding paling lambat H-60 (enam puluh) hari kalender sebelum tanggal berakhirnya Perjanjian, sesuai dengan Service Level Agreement ("SLA") Pengadaan yang berlaku sebagai berikut:

Apabila proposal tidak diterima oleh Tim Procurement dalam jangka waktu tersebut, maka terdapat risiko keterlambatan proses pengadaan yang dapat berdampak pada ketidaksesuaian dengan tanggal efektif yang diharapkan oleh Pihak User.

Dalam hal proposal pengadaan Barang dan/atau Jasa dimaksud telah diajukan sebelumnya atau sudah tidak diperlukan, maka email Contract Expiry Reminder ini dapat diabaikan.

Demikian disampaikan, atas perhatian dan kerja samanya kami ucapkan terima kasih.
